verdict.rationale: Base44 documents multiple official MCP servers: an App MCP server exposing published apps to external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), an account-level MCP server for any MCP-compatible assistant, and a dedicated Docs MCP server — all first-party documented features, consistent with Base44's role as a platform/backend service rather than an agent itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of MCP server usage in practice.
